1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# --dry-run applies to ALL run modes (fast, cycle, hybrid): it prints the exact
3	# command(s) andesim WOULD spawn, shell-quoted, and executes nothing. Regression
4	# guard for the bug where fast/cycle silently ignored --dry-run and ran the
5	# program (e.g. `run --mode fast hello.elf --dry-run` printed "hello").
6	#
7	# Layers:
8	#   1. fast   (always; needs only build/andesim + a fixture ELF): prints the
9	#      full qemu command, exit 0, executes nothing.
10	#   2. cycle  (needs a built vsim engine; SKIPs otherwise): the vsim standalone
11	#      command, exit 0, executes nothing.
12	#   3. hybrid (regression): still prints 2 commands.
13	set -uo pipefail
14	
15	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
16	ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
17	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
18	
19	bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
20	BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
21	[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "missing andesim binary: $BIN"
22	elf=$(ls "$ROOT"/tests/fixtures/handoff_roundtrip.elf 2>/dev/null \
23	      || ls "$ROOT"/tests/fixtures/*.elf 2>/dev/null | head -1)
24	[ -n "$elf" ] || fail "no fixture ELF under tests/fixtures"
25	
26	# 1. fast: --dry-run prints the full qemu command and runs nothing. Use the
27	#    reported arg order (flag AFTER the ELF) to lock the repro.
28	out=$(timeout 30 "$BIN" run --mode fast "$elf" --dry-run 2>&1); rc=$?
29	[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "fast --dry-run exit $rc (should preview, not run): $out"
30	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'dry-run: 1 command' \
31	  || fail "fast --dry-run did not print the preview banner (it executed?): $out"
32	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '-machine andes_ae350' \
33	  || fail "fast --dry-run missing the qemu command: $out"
34	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '-bios' \
35	  || fail "fast --dry-run missing -bios <elf>: $out"
36	ok "fast: --dry-run prints the full qemu command, executes nothing"
37	
38	# Resolve a built vsim engine the way the driver does (VSIM_BIN_DIR env, then
39	# config.env), else the legacy in-tree build dir.
40	vsim_bin_dir() {
41	  if [ -n "${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$VSIM_BIN_DIR"; return; fi
42	  local v
43	  v=$(grep -oP 'VSIM_BIN_DIR=\K.*' "$ROOT/config.env" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '"' | head -1)
44	  [ -n "$v" ] && printf '%s\n' "$v" || printf '%s\n' "$ROOT/verilator/build"
45	}
46	BINDIR=$(vsim_bin_dir)
47	SIM=$(ls "$BINDIR"/sim_* 2>/dev/null | grep -vE '\.(json|txt)$' | head -1)
48	if [ -z "$SIM" ] || [ ! -x "$SIM" ]; then
49	  ok "SKIP cycle + hybrid --dry-run: no built vsim engine under $BINDIR (set VSIM_BIN_DIR)"
50	  exit 0
51	fi
52	id="vsim:$(basename "$SIM" | sed 's/^sim_//')"
53	
54	# 2. cycle: standalone vsim engine, --dry-run previews its command, runs nothing.
55	out=$(timeout 30 env VSIM_BIN_DIR="$BINDIR" "$BIN" run --mode cycle --dry-run \
56	      --engine "$id" "$elf" 2>&1); rc=$?
57	[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "cycle --dry-run exit $rc (should preview, not run): $out"
58	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'dry-run: 1 command' \
59	  || fail "cycle --dry-run did not print the preview banner (it executed?): $out"
60	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "$(basename "$SIM")" \
61	  || fail "cycle --dry-run missing the vsim command: $out"
62	ok "cycle: --dry-run prints the vsim standalone command, executes nothing"
63	
64	# 3. hybrid regression: still 2 commands (probe -> stage -> inject path intact).
65	out=$(timeout 30 env VSIM_BIN_DIR="$BINDIR" "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker \
66	      --dry-run --engine "$id" "$elf" 2>&1)
67	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'dry-run: 2 command' \
68	  || fail "hybrid --dry-run regression: not 2 commands: $out"
69	ok "hybrid: --dry-run still prints 2 commands"

# Shared status printers for test scripts. Sourced (not executed).
#
#   fail <msg...>          -> "[FAIL] <msg>" on stderr, exit 1
#   ok   <msg...>          -> "[ok] <msg>" on stdout
#   expect <rc> <re> CMD.. -> run CMD, fail unless it exits <rc> and its
#                             combined output matches the <re> regex
#
# These patterns were duplicated byte-identically across many test scripts.
# Source via:   . "$SCRIPT_DIR/<rel>/lib/log.sh"

fail() { echo "[FAIL] $*" >&2; exit 1; }
ok()   { echo "[ok] $*"; }

expect() {
  local want="$1" re="$2"; shift 2
  local out rc
  out=$("$@" 2>&1 </dev/null); rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq "$want" ] || fail "rc=$rc want $want for [$*]: $out"
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq "$re" || fail "missing /$re/ for [$*]: $out"
}

# Repo root, derived from this lib's own location (tests/lib/ -> ../..).
_LIB_ROOT=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)

# cfg_val KEY -> the value of KEY in the repo-root config.env ("" if absent).
# A lightweight read so a test runs without a prior `source ./setup.sh`.
cfg_val() { grep -oP "$1=\\K.*" "$_LIB_ROOT/config.env" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '"' | head -1; }

# The external vsim build dir (the sim_* binaries), the way the driver resolves
# it: VSIM_BIN_DIR env, then config.env, then the legacy in-tree build dir.
vsim_bin_dir() {
  if [ -n "${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$VSIM_BIN_DIR"; return; fi
  local v; v=$(cfg_val VSIM_BIN_DIR)
  [ -n "$v" ] && printf '%s\n' "$v" || printf '%s\n' "$_LIB_ROOT/verilator/build"
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# QEMU-match feature: vsim `--print-qemu-config` emits the engine's QEMU
# `-readconfig` cfg -- its config.inc distilled to per-extension `[global]`
# properties -- and the andesim plan executor injects it into the QEMU fast leg
# so the functional engine runs the same ISA the cycle-accurate engine models.
#
# Two layers:
#   1. unit (fast, always runs): plan-test covers stage_qemu_cfg (probe ->
#      workdir/qemu.cfg, with the tolerant fallback) and the fast-leg-only
#      `-readconfig` injection. Pure; no engine.
#   2. engine contract (needs a built vsim engine; SKIPs otherwise):
#      sim_<cpu> --print-qemu-config exits 0 and emits a [global] block whose
#      driver is andes-<family>-riscv-cpu (the family the QEMU leg selects).
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

# 1. unit: stage_qemu_cfg + the -readconfig injection contract
bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
PLANTEST="$ROOT/build/driver/andesim-plan-test"
[ -x "$PLANTEST" ] || fail "missing unit-test binary: $PLANTEST"
"$PLANTEST" >/dev/null || fail "plan unit tests (stage_qemu_cfg / -readconfig) failed"
ok "unit: stage_qemu_cfg + fast-leg -readconfig injection"

# 2. engine contract. Resolve a built vsim engine the way the driver does:
#    VSIM_BIN_DIR (env, then config.env), else the legacy in-tree build dir.
vsim_bin_dir() {
  if [ -n "${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$VSIM_BIN_DIR"; return; fi
  local v
  v=$(grep -oP 'VSIM_BIN_DIR=\K.*' "$ROOT/config.env" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '"' | head -1)
  [ -n "$v" ] && printf '%s\n' "$v" || printf '%s\n' "$ROOT/verilator/build"
}
BINDIR=$(vsim_bin_dir)
SIM=$(ls "$BINDIR"/sim_* 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -z "$SIM" ] || [ ! -x "$SIM" ]; then
  ok "SKIP engine contract: no built vsim engine under $BINDIR (set VSIM_BIN_DIR)"
  exit 0
fi
